column7: When choosing the worker for a task: route by fleet/specs/model-routing.md, not 'Opus by default'. Set a seat's model AT LAUNCH (SEAT_MODEL_ENV); never send /model into a pane (it rewrites Kam's global default). QA gate before every merge. Spark clauses dead.

Regenerable build leftovers (stale node_modules, old CI/QA scratch clones) not in use: the project's seat deletes ITS OWN, df before/after; other seats' trees or >1 project = card for Kam. Never records, anything touched in 3 days or a live seat's tree.

When I trust a control: run it in the judge's exact mode, invoker and ref set; canary = a value the rule is known to detect; check scan counts against git log. Before a brief names a path, file or dependency: read the property that governs it, not its size.
